faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept UPI, credit/debit cards, net banking, wallets (Paytm, PhonePe), EMI on select cards, and Cash on Delivery.

faqs.question: Is COD available?
faqs.answer: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available on most orders below 50000. Availability depends on your pincode.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days. Express delivery (1-2 days) is available at extra cost in select cities.

faqs.question: Do you deliver internationally?
faqs.answer: Currently, ShopEase delivers only within India.

faqs.question: Can I track my order?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can track your order in real-time from the 'My Orders' section using your order ID.

faqs.question: What is the return window?
faqs.answer: Electronics: 7 days, Fashion: 15 days, Home: 10 days. Some categories like groceries and customized items are non-returnable.

faqs.question: How do I return an item?
faqs.answer: Go to 'My Orders' → select the item → click 'Return' → choose reason → schedule pickup. Pickup is free for ShopEase Assured items.

faqs.question: When will I get my refund?
faqs.answer: UPI/wallet: within 24 hours after pickup. Cards: 5-7 business days. EMI: in next billing cycle.

faqs.question: Can I get a refund to a different account?
faqs.answer: Refunds are issued only to the original payment method for security reasons.

faqs.question: How do I claim warranty?
faqs.answer: Visit the brand's authorized service center with your ShopEase invoice. We can email you a copy of the invoice if needed.

faqs.question: Does warranty cover physical damage?
faqs.answer: No, manufacturer warranty does not cover physical or liquid damage. Only manufacturing defects are covered.

faqs.question: Why is my coupon not working?
faqs.answer: Common reasons: coupon expired, minimum cart value not met, item not eligible, or already-discounted item. Check the coupon T&C.

faqs.question: Can I use multiple coupons?
faqs.answer: Only one coupon can be applied per order. Bank offers may stack with select coupons during sale events.

faqs.question: How do I create an account?
faqs.answer: Click 'Sign Up' on the homepage, enter your phone or email, verify the OTP, and you're done.

faqs.question: How do I reset my password?
faqs.answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your registered email/phone, and follow the OTP-based reset link.

faqs.question: How do I delete my account?
faqs.answer: Go to Settings → Privacy → Delete Account. Account deletion is permanent and removes order history.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: Yes, before shipment. Once shipped, you can refuse delivery or initiate a return after delivery.

faqs.question: What if I receive a damaged item?
faqs.answer: Report it within 48 hours via 'My Orders' with photos. You'll get a free replacement or full refund.

faqs.question: How do I download my invoice?
faqs.answer: Go to 'My Orders' → select the order → click 'Download Invoice'. It's available as a PDF.

faqs.question: How do I contact customer support?
faqs.answer: Use in-app chat, email support@shopease.com, or call 1800-XXX-XXXX (9 AM – 9 PM, all days).
